title: algerian plant-based tagine with lime and preserved lemon
description: energizing tagine recipe with smoky flavors, featuring unwaxed lime and preserved lemon, perfect for a plant-based breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: use a store-bought blend or make your own

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use a flaky sea salt or kosher salt

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: use a freshly ground black pepper

instructions: heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
add the chopped carrots and red bell pepper, cook for 3-4 minutes.
add the chopped preserved lemon, algerian spice blend, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper.
stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
add the chopped unwaxed lime and stir to combine.
reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
